final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt as diff FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(cnt), AVG(diff) FROM step3
